units.source_text: 乌鸦们依然无视着“希望”。
作为诱饵的干鱼早已经不再是干鱼了。

en.t: The dried fish he had used as bait had long since ceased to be dried fish.

units.source_text: 干鱼被乌鸦们忽视，却没有被细菌忽视。

en.t: The dried fish had been ignored by the crows, but not by the bacteria.

units.source_text: 一天早上，他用细棒尖戳了戳，干鱼只剩下了鱼皮，变成黑黑的、黏乎乎的液体。

en.t: One morning, when he poked it with the tip of a thin stick, only the fish skin remained, and it had turned into a black, sticky liquid.

units.source_text: 于是，他乘更换诱饵之机，想再查看一下装置的情况。

en.t: So, taking the opportunity to replace the bait, he decided to check the device once more.

units.source_text: 谁知拨开沙子，揭掉盖子一看，他大吃一惊。

en.t: But when he brushed away the sand, lifted off the cover, and looked inside, he was astonished.

units.source_text: 原来，桶底竟然囤积着一汪水。

en.t: There, at the bottom of the bucket, a pool of water had somehow gathered.

units.source_text: 水面离桶底大约有十厘米高，透明的水，要比每天分配来的那种锈迹斑斑的水纯净得多。

en.t: The surface of the water stood about ten centimeters above the bottom of the bucket, and the clear water was far purer than the rusty water they were allotted every day.

units.source_text: 最近什么时候下过雨了？……
不，至少这半个月以来没下过雨。

en.t: No, at least for the past half month, there had been no rain.

units.source_text: 那么是半个月以前留下的雨水吗？……

en.t: Then was it rainwater left from more than half a month ago? ...

units.source_text: 他尽可能这样想，可令人不解的是，这个桶是漏水的。

en.t: He tried as hard as he could to think so, but the puzzling thing was that this bucket leaked.

units.source_text: 眼下，把桶提起来，水眼看着慢慢地从桶底漏掉了。

en.t: Even now, when he lifted the bucket, the water visibly seeped slowly out through the bottom.

units.source_text: 那个深度，只要不是位于地下水线，那么，漏去的部分，只能看作有水源源不断从什么地方补充而来。

en.t: At that depth, unless it lay on the groundwater line, the amount that leaked away could only be taken as being constantly replenished from somewhere.

units.source_text: 至少理论上说是这样的。

en.t: At least, that was how it worked in theory.

units.source_text: 但是，这干巴巴的沙子里，水究竟从哪里补充而来的呢？

en.t: But in this bone-dry sand, where on earth was the water being replenished from?
